messages:
Maya (Marketing): Heads up team 11 final push for the public launch + webinar next Thurs. Need social schedule for X + LinkedIn, assets from design, and engagement playbook. Can we lock times today?

Jon (Growth): Goal = webinar signups + demo requests. Also want a clear benchmark narrative (latency vs cost) for retargeting ads.

Priya (Content): I'll draft 3 X thread variants and 2 LinkedIn carousel captions. Need hero image + a 30s clip + 3 short graph clips.

Sam (Design): Confirm specs? X single image 1200x1200, LinkedIn feed 1200x627, carousel 1080x1080, hero clip 1920x1080 mp4 <50MB. Any required brand elements?

Maya (Marketing): CTA color #0057FF, 16px rounded button on slides. Include small footnote on benchmark slide: "testbed and model details inside."

Ava (Social): Recommended schedule: X thread 2:00pm PT (eng audience), LinkedIn 11:00am PT (highest reach), reminder X 24h before, and a day-of post 1h before webinar. We'll test a staging post first.

SocialBot (scheduler): Queued staging posts for 2024-07-30T10:00:00-07:00. Ready to schedule main posts on approval.

Liam (Sales Ops): UTM plan: utm_source=social, utm_medium=x|linkedin, utm_campaign=launch_webinar_jul24. Route signups with "Request demo" to HubSpot queue "Inbound - Social". Add property "benchmark_interest" if they click benchmark asset.

Priya (Content): X thread draft A:
- Tweet 1: We just launched a major Redwood Inference update 1 faster, cheaper LLM inference.
- Tweet 2: Webinar Thurs 9am PT 1 live benchmarks + AMA. RSVP: <link>?utm_campaign=launch_webinar_jul24
- Tweet 3: Snapshot: ~40% lower per-token cost on common configs. Details in thread.

Sam (Design): I'll make benchmark slide mock. Please confirm numbers to show. Want to avoid overclaiming.

Jon (Growth): Use conservative figures: 40% cost reduction, 80-90ms median latency @ 2k tokens on our test config. Call out: "results vary by model & hardware."

Ava (Social): Engagement playbook (short replies): price -> DM with pricing link; SLA/dedicated -> tag @Liam; methodology -> thread link + DM for raw data; demo -> link to form; webinar RSVP -> calendar ics; negative feedback -> request DM. I'll formalize templates.

Liam (Sales Ops): Confirm SocialBot should push lead forms to HubSpot. Map form field "interest" -> "benchmark_interest" tag. SDRs should note organic vs paid on leads for ROI tracking.

Maya (Marketing): Assignments: Priya - final copy + transcript; Sam - hero + slides + clips; Ava - schedule + engagement templates; Jon - UTMs + landing form mapping; Liam - HubSpot routing & notify rules. All due today for 4pm sign-off.

Priya (Content): LinkedIn carousel headline ideas:
Slide1: "How Redwood cut inference costs by 40%"
Slide2: "Real-world latency & cost benchmarks"
Slide3: "See the testbed + join our webinar"
Will finish captions after final numbers.

Sam (Design): Starting assets. Will upload v1 to Drive and share link here when ready. Need transcript for the 30s talking head from Priya.

Priya (Content): Uploading draft transcript now: "Hi, I'm Priya from Redwood Inference. In this webinar we'll walk through the benchmarks that helped our customers cut inference costs while maintaining latency. We'll show the testbed, methodology, and real customer scenarios. Bring questions for the live Q&A."

Ava (Social): Social schedule to queue after assets:
- Staging X + LinkedIn: 2024-07-30T10:00:00-07:00
- Main X thread: 2024-07-31T14:00:00-07:00
- Main LinkedIn: 2024-07-31T11:00:00-07:00
- Reminder X: 2024-08-01T08:00:00-07:00
- Day-of: 2024-08-01T08:00:00-07:00 (1h before webinar)
Will monitor first 2 hours for high-intent replies.

SocialBot (scheduler): Scheduled: staging posts queued. Awaiting asset links to finalize main schedule.

Jon (Growth): If >50 signups in first hour, plan to allocate paid boost to LinkedIn. Also we'll retarget commenters who click benchmark asset.

Maya (Marketing): Engagement escalation: Ava will triage, tag @Liam for enterprise asks, escalate product questions to #eng-ml. Keep replies concise.

Liam (Sales Ops): SDR note: add "source_detail" = organic|paid and whether benchmark_asset_clicked = true|false. Good for attribution.

Ava (Social): I'll draft 6 templated replies and share now:
1) Pricing: "Thanks! We'll DM pricing and link to pricing page: <pricing_url>?utm_campaign=launch_webinar_jul24"
2) SLA/Dedicated: "Tagging @Liam 1 our team will follow up re: enterprise options."
3) Methodology: "We published the testbed & methodology in the thread. DM for raw data."
4) Demo: "Book a demo: <demo_link> 1 choose 'Inbound - Social'"
5) RSVP thanks: "Thanks for signing up 1 add to calendar: <ics_link>"
6) Feedback: "Appreciate this. Could you DM specifics so we can follow up?"

Maya (Marketing): Final checklist before 4pm sign-off:
- [ ] Priya: final copy & transcript (today)
- [ ] Sam: hero image, slides, clips (EOD)
- [ ] Ava: social scheduling + templates (today)
- [ ] Jon: UTMs & landing form mapping (today)
- [ ] Liam: HubSpot routing & notify rule (today)

Priya (Content): All copy + transcript uploaded to Drive: https://drive.company/redwood/launch-assets (placeholder link).

Sam (Design): Uploaded mock v1 link: https://drive.company/redwood/launch-assets/design_v1 (placeholder). Will iterate after feedback.

Ava (Social): Once live, monitor replies for 2 hours and escalate high-intent leads. I'll post a short report in this thread after first hour.

Jon (Growth): Also prepare an ad creative kit if we decide to boost. Sam can slice assets into 1:1 and 4:5 variants.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks all. Reconvene 4pm PT for final sign-off. :rocket:
